//: Scope only (openspec: ci-security-gates, design D3). Accepted findings go in security/accepted-findings.json, never here. scripts/check-accepted-findings.mjs fixes every key and value below.

include_paths keeps a finding when any of its code is in packages/contracts/src outside src/testing/ (test-only contracts production never deploys). Findings only in lib/, node_modules/, vendor/, test/ or script/ are dropped. filter_paths is not used: it drops a finding in src/ that also touches a dependency.
show_ignored_findings makes Slither ignore slither-disable comments and triage files in every file, including dependencies, so the register is the only way to accept a finding.
Informational and optimization detectors are off; they are severity filters, not suppressions. Low and Medium stay on and appear in the uploaded report.
